LESSON: HEALTHY HABITS 1.0 HEALTH

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Healthy habits 1.0 Health

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healthy habits 1.0 Health. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

2. Explain Healthy habits 1.0 Health to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healthy habits 1.0 Health.
4. Show that you can: practice health habits that illustrations, animations, video clips 3.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healthy habits 1.0 Health using examples from school or home.

4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
